integrity: The universal result follows from an exact three-eigenspace Gram-matrix inversion and exact signed-kernel integration; finite rational checks are corroborative, not a universal certificate. Originality was compared against accessible source material, with residual risk from inaccessible or unindexed equivalent work. No independent scientific validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns unit-edge balanced complete multipartite metric graphs with at least three parts of equal size at least two, uniform arclength measure, no vertex atoms, real L2-orthogonal projection onto continuous edgewise-affine splines. It does not cover nonuniform part sizes, higher degree, arbitrary graph structures, weighted measures, or general finite element meshes. The claimed supremum is only within this graph family.
title: Sharp affine least-squares stability on balanced complete multipartite metric graphs
